title: VPC post-deploy: automated API readiness + model concurrency smoke-checker
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Goal: Add an automated, repeatable post-deploy checker that runs after Terraform apply for Redwood Private VPC deployments. This ticket implements the orchestration and test suite that validates API readiness, performs lightweight model load/concurrency tests, and runs a small smoke-test matrix against common routes (generation, chat, embeddings). The check should run in CI (orchestrated by the deployment pipeline), emit structured results to Console metrics, and produce a human-readable runbook entry in the deployment artifact. It must be fast (target < 6 minutes for most deployments), deterministic, and allow safe retries.

Scope:
- Implement an executable test bundle (python/bash) to be invoked by the infra pipeline.
- API readiness probe: verify control-plane API, token exchange, and per-route health endpoints.
- Model concurrency/load probe: spin up a single worker that performs model load and then runs 2 concurrent generation requests at short sequence lengths to exercise KV cache & kernel path; measure p50/p95 latency.
- Smoke tests: validated sample prompts for text-gen, chat (system/message), and embeddings. Validate structured output shape when using function/tool calls.
- Output: JSON results compatible with Console ingestion (latencies, model_variant, errors, run_id).
- Failure modes: define which failures are fatal (prevent release) vs. advisory.

Non-goals: full-scale perf benchmarks, exhaustive model coverage, long-running stability tests (those belong in dedicated workloads).
acceptance_criteria: Post-deploy checker runs automatically at the end of the Terraform apply stage in the private deployment pipeline and returns an explicit pass/fail exit code.
API readiness probe validates token exchange, returns 200 for /health and /v1/models endpoints, and verifies TLS cert and region routing.
Model concurrency probe successfully loads the pinned model variant, executes 2 parallel generation calls, and reports latency and error stats to a JSON artifact.
Smoke tests exercise generation, chat, and embeddings routes; failures are captured with request/response snippets and labeled as either 'blocking' or 'non-blocking' per configuration.
Results are uploaded to the deployment run artifact and an aggregated metric is emitted to Console (private.deploy.postdeploy_check.duration_seconds and private.deploy.postdeploy_check.failed_count).
Runbook entry is generated automatically with a link to the JSON artifact and a short remediation checklist for common failures.
Security review completed: no plaintext secrets in logs; all tokens are minted with short TTL and scrubbed in artifacts.

runbook_snippets: Common failure: model load OOM — remediation: reduce concurrency, switch to quantized variant, or increase worker memory. See runbook step 'Model OOMs'.
If API readiness fails with TLS error: check customer-provided cert chain and ALB configuration; run openssl s_client -connect <host>:443 to inspect.
comments: 2025-03-01 Priya Raman: Initial draft of the checker CLI spec added to ticket. Decided to prioritize a single fast concurrency scenario rather than a full load generator to keep fast feedback in pipelines.
2025-03-03 Liam O'Connor: PoC of readiness probe pushed to infra PR. Token exchange uses short-lived ephemeral token endpoint. Need security sign-off on artifact retention.

2025-03-04 Wei Zhang: Model concurrency probe implemented using local python worker + asyncio; observed a 10% p95 increase when running with embeddings + gen in parallel on the same worker — added isolation flag to run separate processes.
2025-03-06 Rachel: Smoke test prompts and function-call validation added. Found an edge case: tool calling responses arrive with extra fields; comparator updated to ignore unknown keys.

2025-03-07 Security: Reviewed secret handling, recommended scrubbing bearer tokens from console artifact and setting artifacts to private by default. Marked security_review_required as complete in comments.

2025-03-08 QA: Ran end-to-end on staging-private-03. Two failures: one model load transient (retry succeeded), one TLS handshake flakey with an older ALB; documented remediation steps. Moving to In Progress -> aim to unblock by next deploy.
